correctness.rationale: The Gaussian integral provides exact central-slice intensity H_{r,eps}(z)=exp(-z²)[cosh(2 sqrt((1+eps)/(1-r²)) z)+cos(2r sqrt((1+eps)/(1-r²)) z)] up to a positive scalar. Independently symbolically recomputed the Taylor z² coefficient 2eps, q(r)=(-1+6r²-r⁴)/(3(1-r²)²), r*=sqrt(2)-1, q'(r*)=(4+2sqrt2)/3, v(r*)=-8/45 and quadratic fold coefficient -(5/2+5sqrt2/3). Implicit function theorem, scaling y=z²=delta Y and epsilon=delta² E and local concavity give exactly the local square-root, fourth-root and saddle-node structures. Scope explicitly restricts local near-zero peaks and c/a<1, avoiding unsupported global ridge counts.
